reviewed_by: Claude review of component input and menu fixes
reason: Ten verified interface defects across ui/src/components, each with a unit test that fails on main. EditorPreferencesDialog called preventDefault for every key in a shortcut field, so plain Tab and Shift+Tab never moved focus and a keyboard operator could not reach Apply; unmodified Tab now passes through (Mod+Tab is still captured). SecurityBrowserWorkspacePanel derived selectAssessment from searchParams and refresh from selectAssessment, so any query change (a candidate click) re-ran the snapshot fetch, replaced the list with its loader and reopened the assessment WebSocket; the selection callbacks now read the URL through refs so refresh keeps one identity per api/project (the test shows one fetch and one stream open across a candidate select and close, three on main). ResourceActionMenu depended on the inline adapters object every caller passes, re-issuing the actions request on every parent render, and its open menu had no Escape or outside-press close; it now keys on the adapter names, reads callbacks via a ref, and closes on Escape (returning focus) or a pointer press outside. WorkspacePanel file actions were right-click only, unreachable on phones; each row now has an Actions icon button (aria-label, title, aria-haspopup) that opens the existing WorkspaceEntryContextMenu. Controlled type=number inputs in EngagementPolicySettings, SecurityBrowserWorkspacePanel and BrowserResearchSuite stored Number(value), so clearing a field snapped it to 0; they keep the raw text and parse with an empty/NaN guard on save, showing the existing range validation instead. ExecutionInsightDialog disabled every close path while polling a draft for up to 60 s; closing now cancels the poll. ProviderGoalPanel Cancel goal, ProviderSessionAdvanced Restore checkpoint and the Delete assessment metadata button now go through useConfirmation with explicit labels. ChatAttachments More files appends the next page and ChatRecordedContext gains a Newer context control. CommandPalette arrow keys scroll the selected option into view and expose it through aria-activedescendant. WorkspacePanel and TerminalCommandHistoryPanel defer URL.revokeObjectURL after anchor.click() like the other download paths. The 13 vitest files cover every change (56 tests, 18 new); npm run build typechecks and bundles.
exclusions: No Python tests: no backend change. No native tests: no Tauri or Rust change. No Playwright: the changed files map to tool-suggestions (EngagementPolicySettings*), assistant and chat-edit-in-place (Chat*), browser-complete (BrowserResearchSuite*), project-lifecycle (Workspace*) and the remaining-ui-components areas desktop-interface and mobile-layout; their mocked journeys do not press Tab inside a shortcut field, count snapshot fetches across a query change, re-render an inspector with new adapter objects, clear a number field, close a dialog mid-poll, page attachments or recorded context, or time an object URL revoke, and the confirmation dialogs are exercised by the unit tests against the rendered components. The per-row Actions icon in the Workspace file list is the only rendered change; no screenshot baseline was refreshed, and no real-browser pass was run in this session. No full suites.
